column1: # Fixed launch environment for the jail scripts when no client preparation tool is present.
# Format: kind<TAB>value. "env K=V" is set for the client, "arg X" is added to its
# arguments, "forbid-arg X" refuses the launch if the client arguments hold it (a value
# ending in = or : is a prefix, otherwise the name before any = or :). {server} is
# replaced by the jail host address. These are environment variables and arguments only:
# a dead loopback proxy so nothing leaves by HTTP, our gateway, a loopback error-report address, and
# loopback-only crash upload and resource server.
